+ 	"https://nuforc.org/subndx/?id=e202407",
+ 	"https://nuforc.org/subndx/?id=e202406",

+ 	"https://nuforc.org/subndx/?id=e202402",
+ 	"https://nuforc.org/subndx/?id=e202401",
+ 	"https://nuforc.org/subndx/?id=e202312",
+ 	"https://nuforc.org/subndx/?id=e202311",
+ 	"https://nuforc.org/subndx/?id=e202310",
+ 	"https://nuforc.org/subndx/?id=e202309",
+ 	"https://nuforc.org/subndx/?id=e202308",
+ 	"https://nuforc.org/subndx/?id=e202307",
+ 	"https://nuforc.org/subndx/?id=e202306",
+ 	"https://nuforc.org/subndx/?id=e202305",
+ 	"https://nuforc.org/subndx/?id=e202304",
+ 	"https://nuforc.org/subndx/?id=e202303",
+ 	"https://nuforc.org/subndx/?id=e202302",
+ 	"https://nuforc.org/subndx/?id=e202301",
+ 	"https://nuforc.org/subndx/?id=e202212",
+ 	"https://nuforc.org/subndx/?id=e202211",
+ ];
+ 
+ // Create data directory if it doesn't exist
+ const dataDir = path.join(__dirname, "../data/nuforc");
+ if (!fs.existsSync(dataDir)) {
+ 	fs.mkdirSync(dataDir, { recursive: true });
+ }
+ 
+ // Scrape function for a single URL
+ async function scrapeUrl(url) {
+ 	try {
+ 		console.log(&#96;Scraping ${url}...&#96;);
+ 
+ 		// Extract the month/year ID from the URL
+ 		const idMatch = url.match(/id=([a-z0-9]+)$/);
+ 		const id = idMatch ? idMatch[1] : "unknown";
+ 
+ 		// Scrape the page using Firecrawl
+ 		const response = await firecrawl.scrape({
+ 			url,
+ 			elements: {
+ 				table_data: {
+ 					selector: "table tr",
+ 					type: "list",
+ 					attributes: ["text"],
+ 				},
+ 				title: {
+ 					selector: "h1",
+ 					type: "text",
+ 				},
+ 			},
+ 		});
+ 
+ 		// Save the result
+ 		const outputFilePath = path.join(dataDir, &#96;${id}.json&#96;);
+ 		fs.writeFileSync(outputFilePath, JSON.stringify(response, null, 2));
+ 
+ 		console.log(&#96;Saved data for ${id} to ${outputFilePath}&#96;);
+ 		return { id, success: true };
+ 	} catch (error) {
+ 		console.error(&#96;Error scraping ${url}:&#96;, error.message);
+ 		return { url, success: false, error: error.message };
+ 	}
+ }
+ 
+ // Main function to scrape all URLs with rate limiting
+ async function scrapeAllUrls() {
+ 	const results = [];
+ 	// Process URLs in batches to avoid rate limiting
+ 	const batchSize = 5;
+ 
+ 	for (let i = 0; i &lt; urls.length; i += batchSize) {
+ 		const batch = urls.slice(i, i + batchSize);
+ 		console.log(
+ 			&#96;Processing batch ${i / batchSize + 1} of ${Math.ceil(urls.length / batchSize)}&#96;,
+ 		);
+ 
+ 		const batchPromises = batch.map((url) =&gt; scrapeUrl(url));
+ 		const batchResults = await Promise.all(batchPromises);
+ 		results.push(...batchResults);
+ 
+ 		// Wait a bit between batches to avoid rate limits
+ 		if (i + batchSize &lt; urls.length) {
+ 			console.log("Waiting 5 seconds before next batch...");
+ 			await new Promise((resolve) =&gt; setTimeout(resolve, 5000));
+ 		}
+ 	}
+ 
+ 	// Save overall summary
+ 	const summary = {
+ 		totalUrls: urls.length,
+ 		successful: results.filter((r) =&gt; r.success).length,
+ 		failed: results.filter((r) =&gt; !r.success).length,
+ 		results,
+ 	};
+ 
+ 	fs.writeFileSync(
+ 		path.join(dataDir, "scrape-summary.json"),
+ 		JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2),
+ 	);
+ 	console.log(
+ 		&#96;Scraping complete. Total: ${urls.length}, Successful: ${summary.successful}, Failed: ${summary.failed}&#96;,
+ 	);
+ }
+ 
+ // Run the scraper
+ scrapeAllUrls().catch((error) =&gt; {
+ 	console.error("Fatal error:", error);
+ 	process.exit(1);
+ });
+

+ // Function to extract the report ID from a URL
+ function getReportIdFromUrl(url) {
+ 	const match = url.match(/id=([a-z0-9]+)$/);
+ 	return match ? match[1] : "unknown";
+ }
+ 
+ // Function to parse a NUFORC report table
+ function parseNuforcTable($) {
+ 	const reports = [];
+ 
+ 	// Extract table headers
+ 	const headers = [];
+ 	$("table thead tr th").each((i, elem) =&gt; {
+ 		headers.push($(elem).text().trim());
+ 	});
+ 
+ 	// Extract table data
+ 	$("table tbody tr").each((i, row) =&gt; {
+ 		const reportData = {};
+ 
+ 		$(row)
+ 			.find("td")
+ 			.each((j, cell) =&gt; {
+ 				if (j &lt; headers.length) {
+ 					const header = headers[j].toLowerCase();
+ 					const value = $(cell).text().trim();
+ 
+ 					// Handle link cells
+ 					if (header === "link" &amp;&amp; $(cell).find("a").length) {
+ 						reportData[header] = {
+ 							text: value,
+ 							url: $(cell).find("a").attr("href"),
+ 						};
+ 					} else {
+ 						reportData[header] = value;
+ 					}
+ 				}
+ 			});
+ 
+ 		if (Object.keys(reportData).length &gt; 0) {
+ 			reports.push(reportData);
+ 		}
+ 	});
+ 
+ 	return { headers, reports };
+ }
